test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

I remember to meet her at a conference in Delhi last year.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **to meet her**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **'to meet' **with **'meeting'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Meet **(noun) means to come together by chance or because you have arranged it.
 
• **To + verb** is called the infinitive. **To + verb + ing** is not correct in any situation.
 
• It is because a gerund is treated as a noun. You remember a thing (a noun), not the infinitive of a verb.
 
• **Some of our verbs are followed by “actions,” which are actually direct objects that function as nouns.**
 
• You can’t say *“I remember to meet him yesterday.”*
 
• You have to say either *“I remember meeting him yesterday,” *or *“I remember that I met him yesterday.”*

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4 **which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *I remember** meeting her __**at a conference in Delhi last year.*
